args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0 in `requirements.txt` to address CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Versions <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0,<3.1.0 are affected; 3.1.0 is the fixed version on the 3.x line, consistent with the team's fastjson 3.x migration.

## Testing
- CI passed on commit 13fee7191e (run ci-0001).

Requesting review from @alex (code owner) — merging to main needs code-owner approval.
